en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a town square bordered by trees, with groups of people—including children and adults—stood or walking about. In the background, there is a large building with visible signage, and the square is surrounded by further period-style buildings. The overall setting suggests a typical European town scene from the early 20th century. There is red printed and handwritten text on the image.
